entities.title: Clone Spell
entities.summary: 3-housing 3.5-tile zone (18 s) copying entering troops up to 22-48 housing; clones live 30 s; no Heroes/Pets/Siege.

entities.title: Freeze Spell
entities.summary: 1-housing 3.5-tile instant freeze of defenses and defending units for 2.5-6.0 s; only things inside at cast are affected.

entities.title: Healing Spell
entities.summary: 2-housing 5-tile healing ring: 41 pulses every 0.3 s (15-75 HP per pulse), Heroes healed at 55%, Siege Machines unaffected.

entities.title: Invisibility Spell
entities.summary: 1-housing 4-tile field making all units and buildings except Walls/Siege untargetable for 3.5-4.25 s.

entities.title: Jump Spell
entities.summary: 2-housing 3.5-tile zone that lets wall-bound ground units path over Walls for 20-100 s.

entities.title: Lightning Spell
entities.summary: 1-housing single bolt: 150-720 damage in a 2-tile radius plus a 0.1 s stun; storages, Town Hall and Clan Castle immune.

entities.title: Rage Spell
entities.summary: 2-housing 5-tile ring for 18 s: +20..+32 speed and +130..+190% damage (additive), Heroes get half, no self-stacking.

entities.title: Recall Spell
entities.summary: 2-housing 5-tile spell returning 83-120 housing of troops/Heroes/Pets to the deploy bar (Heroes first).

entities.title: Revive Spell
entities.summary: 2-housing single-target spell reviving the nearest knocked-out Hero within 8 tiles at 60-80% HP.

entities.title: Totem Spell
entities.summary: 1-housing decoy: stuns a 5-tile area on impact and leaves a 10,000-13,000 HP Totem (ground+air target) decaying 334 HP/s.

entities.title: Angry Spell
entities.summary: 1-housing 6-tile field (5 s) that forces non-defense-targeting units to target defenses for 7-12 s (added June 2026).

entities.title: Bat Spell
entities.summary: 1-housing summon of 7-25 defense-targeting Bats over a few seconds; weak vs storages/Town Hall; no traps/CC triggers.

entities.title: Earthquake Spell
entities.summary: 1-housing max-HP-percentage quake (14.5-29% to buildings, extra wall formula, 5-14.5% to ground troops at L6-8) with diminishing repeats.

entities.title: Haste Spell
entities.summary: 1-housing speed-only boost (+28..+56) for 10-30 s in a 4-tile (5 at L7) area; Heroes get half; no stacking with Rage speed.

entities.title: Ice Block Spell
entities.summary: 1-housing 5-tile snapshot that encases friendly units for 7 s: immobile and silent but taking 86-96% less damage.

entities.title: Overgrowth Spell
entities.summary: 2-housing 6-tile root trap: buildings disabled, untargetable and invulnerable for 22-26 s; Walls, traps, defending units unaffected.

entities.title: Poison Spell
entities.summary: 1-housing 4-tile cloud for 16 s: ramping damage to 90-380 DPS, -26..-52% speed and -35..-74% attack rate on defending units.

entities.title: Skeleton Spell
entities.summary: 1-housing summon of 12-19 armored Skeletons over time; they ignore traps/CC and hit resource buildings weakly.

entities.title: Battle Blimp
entities.summary: Flying siege that flies straight at the Town Hall bombing buildings on the way; explodes for 700-1,200 on death.

entities.title: Battle Drill
entities.summary: Underground siege that tunnels to defenses, stuns nearby defenses and destroys Walls on surfacing, then drills (1.7 s single target).

entities.title: Flame Flinger
entities.summary: Long-range ground catapult targeting defenses: bursts of 3 Fire Spirits every 5 s leaving ramping burn zones; decays 17 HP/s.

entities.title: Log Launcher
entities.summary: Slow ground siege rolling piercing logs (20 tiles / 4 buildings, x4 vs Walls) plus a point-blank blast; loses 156 HP/s.

entities.title: Siege Barracks
entities.summary: Stationary 30 s siege that spawns P.E.K.K.As then Wizards (1+6 to 2+12) and releases CC troops when it ends.

entities.title: Sky Wagon
entities.summary: Flying barrel-launcher siege (April 2026): 4-5 barrels every 8 s, each releasing Minions, a Balloon, a Baby Dragon and 1 CC troop.

entities.title: Stone Slammer
entities.summary: Flying defense-targeting siege: 2.5 s boulder drops with a 1-tile heavy hitbox and a 3-tile hitbox (x25 vs Walls), 500 death damage.

entities.title: Troop Launcher
entities.summary: Stationary siege that lobs 5-7 barrels (Giant, Barbarians, Archers, Wall Breakers + 1 CC troop each) at friendly groups; decays 25 HP/s.

entities.title: Wall Wrecker
entities.summary: Ground siege that rams a path to the Town Hall: 1.3 s splash hits (x10 vs Walls), 5,500-10,000 HP.

entities.title: Ice Hound
entities.summary: Boosted Lava Hound (40 housing): tank that targets Air Defenses, slows what it hits, freezes the area and drops Ice Pups on death.

entities.title: Inferno Dragon
entities.summary: Boosted Baby Dragon (15 housing): single-target Inferno Beam ramping from base DPS to 2x after 1.7 s and 20x after 3.2 s.

entities.title: Rocket Balloon
entities.summary: Boosted Balloon (8 housing): Boosters give a large speed burst for 4 s after deployment; defense-targeting bomber.

entities.title: Sneaky Goblin
entities.summary: Boosted Goblin (3 housing): resource raider (x2 vs resources) that is invisible for 5 s after deployment.

entities.title: Super Archer
entities.summary: Boosted Archer (12 housing): long-range piercing arrows (Sharp Shot) that damage every building in the line.

entities.title: Super Barbarian
entities.summary: Boosted Barbarian (5 housing): melee with Rage for 8 s after deployment (+70% damage, speed boost).

entities.title: Super Bowler
entities.summary: Boosted Bowler (30 housing): Triple Strike boulders bounce three times (3 tiles apart) with 0.6-tile splash at each impact.

entities.title: Super Dragon
entities.summary: Boosted Dragon (40 housing): Roast - bursts of 10 splash fire shots 0.192 s apart with 1.8 s between bursts.

entities.title: Super Giant
entities.summary: Boosted Giant (10 housing): very tanky defense-targeter whose Wall Buster ability deals 5x damage to Walls.

entities.title: Super Hog Rider
entities.summary: Boosted Hog Rider (12 housing): wall-jumping defense-targeter that splits into a Super Rider and a Super Hog on death.

entities.title: Super Miner
entities.summary: Boosted Miner (24 housing): tunnels between targets, drill damage ramps over 1.5/3 s, explodes on death (2-tile radius).

entities.title: Super Minion
entities.summary: Boosted Minion (12 housing): Long Shot fires its first 8 shots (3 on defense) from long range; triggers Seeking Air Mines.

entities.title: Super Valkyrie
entities.summary: Boosted Valkyrie (20 housing): splash spinner that drops a Rage Spell-like field (L4 Rage strength, 4-tile radius) on death.

entities.title: Super Wall Breaker
entities.summary: Boosted Wall Breaker (8 housing): Mega Bomb always explodes (attack + death damage), x40 vs Walls, 1.6-tile splash.

entities.title: Super Witch
entities.summary: Boosted Witch (40 housing): summons one Big Boy (4,100 HP, 350 DPS) at a time instead of Skeleton swarms.

entities.title: Super Wizard
entities.summary: Boosted Wizard (10 housing): Chain Magic hits a primary target and chains to up to 9 more within 3 tiles at 40% damage.

entities.title: Super Yeti
entities.summary: Boosted Yeti (35 housing): spawns chain-lightning Electromites as it takes damage (7-14 per life).

entities.title: Clan Castle
entities.summary: Reinforcement building: 10-55 troop, 1-4 spell and 1-2 siege housing by level; Siege Machines carry and release CC troops.

entities.title: Dark Spell Factory
entities.summary: TH8 army building (8 levels) unlocking the Dark spells; adds a flat +1 spell housing to the shared pool.

entities.title: Spell Factory
entities.summary: TH5 army building (9 levels) that unlocks the 10 Elixir spells and provides 2-10 spell housing (shared with the Dark Spell Factory's +1).

entities.title: Workshop
entities.summary: TH12 army building (9 levels) that builds Siege Machines instantly and stores 1-3 of them; one siege per battle.

entities.title: Siege Machines
entities.summary: Overview: Workshop-built machines that carry Clan Castle troops, ignore spells, and release troops when destroyed; one per battle.

entities.title: Super Troops
entities.summary: Boosting rules (Super Sauna): TH11+, base troop at its minimum level, 25,000 DE or a Super Potion, 3 days, max two types, no cooldown; level = base level.
